database.description: The database the points go to (a bucket on InfluxDB 2.x).

lines.description: Line protocol, one point per line: measurement,tag=value field=value timestamp. A person approves the exact points.

precision.description: The unit of the timestamps: nanoseconds, microseconds, milliseconds or seconds.

retentionPolicy.description: InfluxDB 1.x only: the retention policy the points go to. Empty: the database's default.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
